test_name: Verify Filtering Accessories by Price Range
description: This test ensures that users can apply a price range filter to the Accessories category and view products within the specified price range.
steps: Navigate to the Accessories category page.
Input the minimum price in the 'Min price' field.
Input the maximum price in the 'Max price' field.
Verify that the page reloads or updates dynamically.
Scroll through the list of filtered products.
Click on a product to view its details.
Verify that the product price falls within the specified range.
expected_results: Products within the specified price range are displayed.
No products outside the specified range are shown.
Price filter inputs are retained after filtering.
edge_cases: No products found within the specified range.
User inputs non-numeric values in the price fields.
User inputs overlapping or reversed price ranges.
Filter button fails to trigger the update.
Price filter input fields are disabled.
data_requirements: Dynamic filtering logic on the backend.
Frontend display logic for filtered items.
dependencies: Products must exist in the Accessories category.
Price filter functionality must be implemented.
Dynamic loading or AJAX for filtering results.
api_interactions: API call to fetch filtered products based on price range.
performance_metrics: Response time of the filter operation.
accessibility_requirements: Labels for price fields must be accessible to screen readers.
Filter button must have ARIA roles.
Ensure keyboard navigation is supported for filter inputs.
